name: Ticket wave
description: Builds a set of tickets from the scratch directory at the same time, each in its own git worktree and branch running ticket-implement, and merges each one back once it's done. A single-thread run builds them one after another instead.

parameters.label: Tickets
parameters.description: Ticket ids (their file names in the scratch directory without .md), comma-separated.

parameters.label: Reviewers
parameters.description: The reviewers each ticket goes through at once, comma-separated: each is a review-<name> common step (built in: standards, specs, style). Add your own review-<name> step to add a reviewer.
